name: banzai-onboarding
description: banzai-onboarding (M2.19G.3, ADR-037): pure Rust security-decision engine for BanzAI-hosted operator onboarding — passwordless email OTP (HMAC-SHA256 digest under a server pepper, single-use/expiry/attempts, constant-time verify), opaque server-side session hashing, the candidate state machine, the .well-known origin-ownership challenge + verification receipt, and the rate-limit policy. Pure JSON-in/JSON-out: no I/O, no clock, no randomness inside — the Node host supplies CSPRNG entropy + the current time and executes all persistence; Rust decides. Onboarding is a hosted service, never a protocol rule (ADR-037).
